name: EvoSynth-Bench: Real-World Benchmark Splits and Results for AutoML Meta-Optimizers
description: Benchmark definition used to evaluate the EvoSynth meta-optimizer: eight real-world datasets (Covertype, HIGGS, Adult, Airlines, Poker Hand, MiniBooNE, Jannis, Fashion-MNIST) with the exact held-out test, search and retraining rows (data_seed 42), the preprocessing, and a loader that fetches each dataset from its original source. The datasets themselves are not redistributed. Version 2.1 adds the first results on these splits (seed 42, Covertype and Adult): held-out test scores of EvoSynth, Random Search, Optuna TPE, FLAML and untuned models, an optimizer ablation, a speed-up benchmark, Fashion-MNIST NAS, and every evaluation's trajectory.
